# SEO strategy · noorhaldar.example

Last revised 2026-10-20 · Revision log at the end

## Long-term objectives

Consulting clients who search for Airflow reliability help, and a first page for "Noor Haldar" that the owner controls.

## Target search categories

| Category | Examples | Why | Realistic now? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Name and brand | noor haldar, noor haldar data engineer | Prospective clients check the name | Yes, once /about.html is indexable |
| Expertise topics | airflow retries, airflow sensors reschedule | Proves expertise; the owner has incidents to write from | Long-tail yes; broad "airflow" no |
| Projects | pipeline-lint, airflow dag linter | The tool is the owner's strongest asset | Yes |

## Brand search strategy

Homepage as the hub for the name; about page as the full profile; GitHub and LinkedIn as supporting owned profiles, all linking back.

## Keyword strategy

Name first, then pipeline-lint, then one Airflow reliability cluster (retries, sensors, idempotency).

## Content strategy

One article a month from real incidents (owner's cadence). Pillar later: "Airflow reliability" once three supporting articles exist.

## Technical priorities

Indexability of /about.html (SEO-003), the canonical on the retries article (SEO-005), then the sitemap (SEO-010).

## Authority strategy

pipeline-lint README and docs link to the site; one meetup talk already given; a podcast or guest article in 2027.

## Competitive positioning

Tutorial sites cover Airflow basics; few write from production failures. Lead with incidents and fixes.

## Geography and language

English, global remote market; Dhaka mentioned for local meetups.

## Audiences

Data engineers and their leads, already using Airflow, debugging production problems.

## KPIs

| KPI | Source | Cadence | Better means |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Name query impressions and clicks | Search Console (not connected yet) | monthly | rising |
| Owned results on page one for "noor haldar" | Snapshot, web search tool, same query set | monthly | more owned or earned results |
| Non-brand impressions | Search Console | monthly | rising |

## Assumptions

- ASSUMED: target market is global remote → confirm with the owner
- ASSUMED: no prominent namesake → check at each snapshot
